Lemma
[Integral-curve criterion for preserving a convex set] ↗ def:vector-field-preserves-convex-set

For closed convex $Z\subset V$ and smooth $\psi $ near $Z$, $\psi $ preserves $Z$ iff every integral curve of $\psi $ starting in $Z$ remains in $Z$. This is the standard convex-set criterion \cite{Hamilton4MPCO}.
